pipeline_timing_scope.staging_ms: CPU geometry calculation; REGISTERED=1 does not copy to pinned staging
pipeline_timing_scope.gpu_ms: CUDA event interval around Graph H2D + CUDA preprocessing + TensorRT + D2H, not model-only
pipeline_timing_scope.postprocess_ms: CPU confidence filtering, coordinate recovery and invalid-box rejection; no drawing
pipeline_timing_scope.total_ms: Host-clock request start through completed CPU postprocess, including launch/synchronization overhead
pipeline_timing_scope.wall_ms: Measured loop, including timing-query and record bookkeeping; excludes warmup/setup/teardown, decode, drawing, file IO

limitations: Engine-only uses GPU-resident fixed input and trtexec pipelined Graph submission; not host request latency or end-to-end FPS
Only final exported output per engine run and final detection list per image are archived, not output on every timed request
Engine output JSON uses text-rounded scores; the separate 21-image binary-output audit is the bitwise correctness evidence
48k measurements repeat two images; this is not 48k independent inputs, labeled accuracy or statistical significance
Two builds per variant used an evolving cache; control_a and control_b Inspector layouts differ, so retain separate build summaries
No locked GPU clocks or controlled-background guarantee; GPU telemetry and run order remain in metadata
